theirReference: Cristian was a very good host. The house is in a part of the city close to la candelaria, but it is not super safe to walk around alone. He was very nice with us, as well as his girlfriend and family who welcomed us very warmly. We slept in the roof because the guest room was already occupied by other two couchsurfer, we slept on two mattresses with a beautiful view, but not very clean environment. Overall the experience was nice and it’s definitely a good option if u come to Bogotà for few days.
myReference: Filippo stayed with his friend and was a wonderful guest, very kind and genuinely interested in learning about the local culture. He was very clean and respectful at all times. Communication was always good, and he followed all the house rules. 😇 We went for a walk around La Candelaria, and he is a very open-minded, intelligent, and interesting person. His Spanish is very good, which made conversations even more enjoyable. 🤩 I also truly appreciate the thoughtful detail of the cookies he brought from his hometown. 🤗 Hosting him was definitely a great experience, and I would happily recommend him to any future host. 💫 È stato un grande piacere conoscerti. Spero di rivederti presto. Un abbraccio :)
